data.standardized_narrative: At 1 January 2016 gross claims outstanding were GBP 13.54m. During 2016 the Syndicate recorded an over-provision (a release) in respect of prior claims of GBP 2.694m (gross), driven by favourable claims development, resulting in a net reduction in prior year reserves of approximately 19.9% of opening gross claims. The syndicate principally writes reinsurance (treaty) business and catastrophe events in 2016 (e.g. Alberta wildfires, Hurricane Matthew) had only a modest impact on the portfolio.

data.data_quality_notes: All source amounts in the accounts are stated in GBP 000. Opening reserves and the prior year movement were taken from the Technical Provisions note (gross column) and converted to millions. The claims development table (gross) is present in the notes (pages 60-61) and was not used as the Technical Provisions line explicitly shows the prior-year over-provision. No RITC distortion affecting the gross prior year movement was identified for Syndicate 6104.
